Lead Management: GHL pipeline cleaned; missed calls contacted up to 7 times via tracked calls only; manual syncing with House Call Pro ongoing.
Advertising Strategy: Multi-step text follow-ups and negative keywords reduce low-value leads; tune-up campaigns aim to lift conversions from 5–11% to 8–15%.
Local Service Ads: LSA leads cost $90–$93 each; Google is migrating LSA to Ads pay-per-lead model; LSA call tagging in GHL is broken and under review.
Client Feedback: Contract at $2,000/month; client satisfied with GHL but wants better communication and biweekly reviews; urgent fix needed for Fibbit visibility drop.
action_items: Sohib Boundaoui
Investigate cause of Fibbid profile’s declining Google organic calls and drops in ranking (19:31)
Confirm accuracy of zero Fibbid profile calls for August and source data discrepancies with GHL (20:07)
Adjust GHL lead management pipeline to include 'attempted contact' and 'engaged' statuses separate from 'contacted' (01:14:20)
Set up notification and AI pipeline automations in GHL to alert team to lead engagement and missed messages (01:40:10)
Investigate and fix tagging issues where LSA calls are not properly marked in GHL (01:51:30)
